messages:
alice: Heads-up — release bump cutoff at 18:00 UTC today. Please ensure your PRs have a compact changelog one-liner and the PR link before cutoff. Keep it pithy.

ben: Quick: what format exactly for the one-liner? Should we include the migration steps inline?

alice: Keep entries to a single sentence: <type>(component): brief action — PR #NNNN. If it’s a migration, short note only (e.g., 'adds nullable col, run migration'). Longer instructions stay in the PR body or issue.

carla: Also run the local linter: `./tools/changelog-check` before merging. CI will block on missing one-liners or lines >120 chars.

alice: Example snippets to copy: 
```
fix(runtime): avoid duplicate websocket send on reconnect — PR #4231
feat(api): add /v2/ingest endpoint for bulk events — PR #4287
chore(deploy): bump sidecar image for logrotate fix — PR #4300
```
Link the PR (or full URL) so the release script can auto-link entries.

ben: If my change touches multiple components, should I list both?

carla: Prefer a single primary component tag. If it's cross-cutting, pick the most visible area (e.g., `component=api`) and put details in PR body.

devex-bot: Reminder: `changelog-check` supports `--preview` to see how entries will render in the release notes. CI runs it on merge.

alice: Owners, quick status ping: reply when your PRs are lint-clean, one-liner present, and tagged. :point_down:

ben: All set from my side — PRs updated and linter passed. :white_check_mark:

carla: Doing a final sweep now. Backports: add `backport-target: 1.6.x` in PR body if needed.

release-bot: Cutoff notice: bump cutoff at 18:00 UTC. Merges after cutoff go to next bump unless manually approved. DM @eng-releases for exceptions.

alice: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. If CI flags length, trim to action + area + PR.
